about_the_game:
Welcome to LitWin — a chaotic, vertical platformer where you play as Mikhail Litvin himself, climbing through a surreal world of memes, scandals, and internet madness. Your goal? Reach the top. Survive the fall. Escape the toxicity.

But this isn’t just a game. It’s a gateway.

Finish the run — and enter the draw.

Three random players will become playable characters in the next game, fighting iconic media figures in a brutal, no-holds-barred battle for digital supremacy.

Can you climb high enough to become a legend?

Fast-paced, skill-based platforming

Meme-fueled, internet-inspired chaos

"One fall, restart all" mechanics

Real chance to be in the sequel

3 winners. 1 random. No skill — just luck.

Only Up? Nope. Only LitWin.

legal_notice:
Welcome to LitWin, a crazy vertical platformer where you play as Mikhail Litvin himself, climbing through an absurd world of memes, failures, and viral scandals. Your goal is to reach the top without falling into the abyss or into a toxic chat.

But this is not just a game. It's a chance for immortality.
Complete the game and enter the random.
Three random players will become the characters of the next part, where they will engage in a bloody battle to the last click with famous media personalities, from bloggers to haters.

Can you fly higher than anyone else and become an internet legend?

A game of time and reaction
An atmosphere of memes and digital chaos
A unique "fall and start over" mechanic
A real opportunity to get into the next game
Three winners. One random. No chance, only luck.
Only Up? No. Only LitWin.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-Bit / Windows 8 64-Bit / Windows 8.1 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6600K / AMD Phenom™ II X4 810 @ 2.60 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit or Windows® 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-4770 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

short_description: Climb higher, survive the chaos! In LitWin, every jump is a risk. Beat the game — and earn a shot to become a character in the next title. Three random winners will fight iconic media figures in a brutal showdown. Only up. Only forward. Only LitWin.
